body: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a flat UV texture atlas for an existing low-poly Warcraft III phoenix mesh, NOT an illustration of a complete bird. Image 1 is the exact 1024 by 1024 UV layout guide, with v=0 at TOP. Image 2 is approved color and hand-painted feather style reference only. Generate ONE square RGBA texture atlas on actual transparent background. Keep texture parts at exactly the same coordinates as image 1; completely remove all guide wireframe lines, labels, and dark background. Do not rearrange, recenter or pack parts. Large irregular left wing region covering x=0..0.55 and y=0..0.86: paint layered, long tapered phoenix feathers running from the root near (0.55,0.61) toward left/top outer edge. Rich vivid deep crimson red inner shoulder and feather bases, luminous pearly white primary feather tips, bright magenta and amethyst-violet feather margins; natural hand-painted fine barbs and warm deep red occlusion between feathers. Feather artwork fills the wireframe footprint, use ragged feather-shaped alpha cutout only around the outer border, transparent outside. The overlapping gold-outlined shoulder patch x=.24.. .71,y=.29...61 must stay fully opaque with layered CRIMSON small feathers, matching the wing roots. Lower-right cyan/lavender outlined contiguous body/neck/head silhouette from (.42,.70) through (.77,.53) to (.95,.71) back to (.45,.92): fully opaque feather plumage, no internal holes, WHITE luminous chest and throat with cream-white feather shafts, violet shade strokes and crimson back feather layering; the right-facing neck/head at x=.79.. .96,y=.53.. .74 is mainly pearly white with a red crown. Separate very narrow crest strips at x=.63.. .83,y=.01...54 and x=.81.. .86,y=.28...54: crimson bases, purple outer fringes, white pointed tips. Every usable body/shoulder UV region must remain opaque so the original team-color underlayer doesn't show through the entire body. Strong readable feather contrast when downscaled to 512 square. Paint diffuse color only: vibrant fantasy game hand-painting, no photoreal lighting, no plastic, no flat solid-color panels, no metallic specular, no cast shadow, no glow extending outside alpha, no text, no checkerboard, no border, no whole-bird composition, no extra feathers outside specified UV regions.
head: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square 2D UV texture atlas for an existing low-poly fantasy phoenix FACE, BEAK, EYE and MOUTH mesh. This is a flat paint texture atlas, NOT an illustration of a bird. Image 1 is the exact UV placement guide, v=0 at TOP. Image 2 is palette/style only. Keep every painted region in exact normalized coordinates from image 1; no rearrangement and no recentering. Remove all wireframe lines. Use opaque RGBA/RGB. Entire unused background deep burgundy. The large lower-right irregular UV island with vertices around (.63,.558),(.70,.539),(.813,.407),(.931,.376),(.967,.411),(.995,.453),(.976,.693),(.891,.561),(.809,.65),(.663,.69) is BEAK and white cheek transition: ivory-white at the LEFT root .63-.75,.53-.68, warming to a strong gold beak ridge and orange-red occlusion toward the RIGHT hooked tip at (.995,.453) down to (.976,.693). Paint a stylized worn horn/beak diffuse surface, confident ivory ridges, warm golden gradients, red deep grooves; no eyeball inside this large island. The SMALL SEPARATE diagonal quadrilateral with corners (.6977,.3131),(.7594,.3424),(.8007,.3919),(.7365,.3721) is the EYE surface: place a single sharp luminous golden-yellow eye with a dark elongated pupil, vivid warm white catchlight, dark crimson eyeliner, oriented along its top-left to bottom-right slant. This island is mirrored by the mesh to form the two eyes; paint only one eye here. The separate top-right trapezoid/pentagon island spanning x=.844.. .993,y=.172...281 is the INSIDE OF THE MOUTH: dark wine red, almost black central depth, subtle red-pink gum edges. Fill all islands fully opaque with 3 percent padding past their contours; keep regions exactly fixed. Clean hand-painted fantasy RTS game texture, coherent pearl white / vivid crimson / gold / violet palette to match reference. No plastic shine, no 3D object, no head drawing, no complete face, no text, no legend, no checkerboard, no wireframes, no transparent holes. Do not alter the location or proportion of the UV regions.
